BNBL Rookie of the Year Award Announced
When <Luis Frias:player#56819> stepped onto the baseball field, he meant business. His solid play this year has netted the <Liverpool:team#359> rookie center fielder the British National Baseball League Rookie of the Year Award for 2026.

Playing in 24 games, he hit for a .500 average with 53 hits, 4 home runs, 46 RBIs and 36 runs scored.

He received 2 first place votes out of a possible 9. <Reinaldo De La Cruz:player#137663> of the <Liverpool Trojans:team#359> finished second in voting with 1 first place vote, while <Quin Cotton:player#41306> of the <London Mets:team#340> finished third with 3 first place votes.
